title: Seabird streetlight lawsuit settlement
summary: A federal suit by the Conservation Council for Hawaiʻi and the American Bird Conservancy says streetlights threaten three protected seabirds, and a committee recommended a settlement 9–0 in 2025. The matter returned in 2026 as Resolution 26-128 with mediation and a possible trial, and the council then authorized a settlement on terms discussed in closed session.

timeline.text: The settlement terms were discussed in executive session (a closed-door discussion).
The council voted to authorize settling a lawsuit brought by the Conservation Council of Hawaiʻi and the American Bird Conservancy.
A county attorney said mediation (talks led by a neutral person) is set for August 10, 2026, at 9 a.m.
